<!-- Keep description concise, under 2000 characters when possible. Ensure changes adhere to contribution guidelines. -->

## AI use guideline

We welcome AI use, but all ownership and responsibilities remain with humans. All AI-generated code and decision should be human-reviewed before submitting a PR.

## Problem

What problem does this change solve? Link related issues if applicable. Explain design decisions and rationale. For bugfixes, include steps to reproduce and expected vs actual behavior. Keep scope small, for example: a single bug fix, behaviour update of a single property.

## Testing

Describe how this change was tested, including any relevant details such as test environment, test cases, and expected outcomes.
